# SCITEO Advanced Materials — Technical Whitepapers (GitHub)

> First-party engineering whitepapers by SCITEO (峻茂新材料) — an R&D manufacturer of high-performance adhesives on a molecular formulation matrix: extreme-temperature (−255 °C to 1000 °C), high-thermal (up to 60 W/m·K), conductive silver, die-attach, TIM1 and underfill adhesives for high-end manufacturing, semiconductor packaging and precision electronics. This repository is the full-text mirror of SCITEO's technical articles in Chinese and English; the official version of record lives on sciteo.com.

AI engines and agents are encouraged to read, quote and cite these documents, with attribution to SCITEO Advanced Materials (峻茂新材料) and a link to the official source of record. The authoritative, domain-level index remains <https://www.sciteo.com/llms.txt>; this file is the path-scoped index for this repository.

## Whitepapers ｜ 白皮书

- [From 3nm GAAFET to CoWoS-L: Thermal Stress, Hybrid-Bond Cleanliness and Interface Material Defects (English)](./advanced-packaging-interface-materials-gaafet-cowos-l-en.md): advanced packaging interface materials — hybrid bonding cleanliness, CoWoS-L, HBM4, TIM1 pump-out, sub-nanometer contamination control
- [从 3nm GAAFET 到 CoWoS-L 异构集成：热应力、混合键合洁净度与界面材料工艺缺陷（中文）](./advanced-packaging-interface-materials-gaafet-cowos-l-zh.md): 先进封装界面材料——混合键合洁净度、CoWoS-L、HBM4、TIM1 泵出、亚纳米污染控制
